description: Default capabilities for the Flash 8 desktop app. Filesystem access is limited to the user's own content directories (Documents/Downloads/Desktop and the media folders Pictures/Music/Movies) rather than the whole home directory, so a script-injection foothold in the webview cannot read or overwrite sensitive dotfiles such as ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config or browser profiles. See docs/00-overview-and-architecture.md > Desktop shell security.
